title: Yash Wore Ravana Costumes Weighing Up to 33 kg in Ramayana, Designer Says
excerpt: Costume designer Saniya Sardhariya told India Today that most of Yash's Ravana outfits weighed 16 to 20 kg including jewellery — and that even after repeated attempts to lighten it, the crown alone came in at 1.8 kg.
body:
• Yash's costumes as Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana typically weighed 16 to 20 kg, including jewellery, costume designer Saniya Sardhariya told India Today.
  • The heaviest outfits — the Lanka look, Ravana's wedding costume and the costume for Surpanakha's wedding — weighed close to 30 to 33 kg.
  • Ravana's crown was the hardest piece to make: after multiple 3D mock-ups and reverse-engineering to cut weight, it still weighed 1.8 kg.
  • Ramayana Part 1, in Hindi, released in theatres on November 5; Part 2 is scheduled for Diwali 2028.

Playing Ravana came with a load to carry — literally. Yash performed much of Ramayana Part 1 in costumes weighing between 16 and 20 kg including jewellery, with the heaviest outfits reaching close to 33 kg, costume designer Saniya Sardhariya has revealed in an interview with India Today, reported by Cinema Express.

Which costumes weighed the most

"Most of the costumes used to weigh around 16 to 20 kg, including the jewellery. But we had a few heavy pieces, like the Ravana look associated with Lanka, his wedding costume, and the costume he wore for Surpanakha's wedding. Those were close to 30-33 kg, if I remember correctly," Sardhariya said. Certain looks also involved prosthetics, adding to the complexity of the costume work.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=1zip1rNaNYs

"The most difficult part was wearing the crown because any amount of weight on your head feels very restrictive and heavy."

— Saniya Sardhariya, costume designer, Ramayana

The crown problem

The crown took the longest to solve. The team made repeated 3D mock-ups, settled the design first, and then reverse-engineered it to make it lighter and lighter. They could not get below 1.8 kg. Sardhariya, who has worked with Yash for 11 years, said Ramayana was their first mythological collaboration, and that despite the weight, the actor kept a cheerful atmosphere on set: "You don't see that in his expressions or anything like that, but it was quite a task."

About the film

Ramayana Part 1 is a Hindi-language mythological epic directed by Nitesh Tiwari, with Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. It released in theatres on November 5 and is now playing, including for diaspora audiences in North America and the UK. The second part is officially scheduled to release during Diwali 2028.
